Tasting notes

How it ships

Packed in an insulated liner with gel packs at our licensed Ventura, CA facility and handed to the carrier the same morning. Orders placed after Wednesday ship the following Monday so nothing sits in a truck over the weekend.

Age verification

Every order requires an adult 21 or over to sign at delivery. Carriers will not leave beer at the door, and IDs are checked against the name on the order.

What this is

A style prototype for Brew Hunters using the same construction as drinkloverboy.com and popsmith.com: a plain Shopify 2.0 theme plus a small library of custom sections. Products, prices and images are live from the Brew Hunters store.

Tokens

Display: Bricolage Grotesque 800. Body: Hanken Grotesk. Specs/labels: DM Mono. Every section sets its own --bg / --fg pair — the same per-section color system both reference sites use.

Sections to build in Liquid

  • promo-marquee
  • split-hero + arc sticker
  • wave-divider (color-pair setting)
  • value-props
  • brewery-tiles
  • featured-products
  • main-product (gallery, pack selector, plan, accordions)
  • build-a-box (cart line-item properties)
  • review-block · footer

Click any product card to see the PDP; "Build a Box" runs the real twelve-can picker.
